name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold mineral interests in Nevada and Idaho. The company operates a capital-light model — acquiring net smelter return royalties and entering streaming agreements on active and prospective gold projects rather than operating mines directly. Key assets include a 1% NSR royalty on the Olinghouse project in Washoe County, Nevada, and multiple 2% NSR royalties across established Nevada gold trends, with ongoing exploration funding through a $5 million streaming earn-in at Lapon Canyon.
